`minds-admin env deploy` now pushes the tier's `update_feed_base_url` (from its committed `client.toml`) into the connector's per-deploy Modal Secret as `MINDS_UPDATE_FEED_BASE_URL`, so the connector can read the release channels' `<channel>-web.json` web pins. Tiers with no committed feed URL (staging, dev envs) push nothing and keep the deploy-time `MINDS_WEB_TEMPLATE_REF` pin as the live one.
